# Greeting words by language

| Language | Greeting word | Emoji |
|----------|---------------|-------|
| English  | Hello         | 👋    |
| Hindi    | Namaste       | 🙏    |
| Spanish  | Hola          | 🌞    |
| French   | Bonjour       | 🥐    |
| German   | Hallo         | 🍺    |
| Japanese | Konnichiwa    | 🎌    |
| Tamil    | Vanakkam      | 🙏    |
| Klingon  | nuqneH        | 🖖    |
